title: Инспектор Мишлен и шеф на один день  (The Michelin Inspector and Chef for a Day)

scenes.title: Nagiyev's Complaints and Barinov's Fate
scenes.summary: Nagiyev laments that Claude Monet is losing money without Chef Barinov, and Eleonora says he can take Victor back if Victor agrees.

scenes.title: The First Clue and Baby Expenses
scenes.summary: Katya starts following secret clues to find her missing hat, while Max asks Kostya how to afford baby supplies on a cook's salary.

scenes.title: The Savings Plan and the Mysterious Note
scenes.summary: Kostya advises Max to propose a cost-saving plan to get a raise, while Katya suspects Denis of hiding her hat.

scenes.title: Nagiyev Invites Barinov Back to Monet
scenes.summary: Nagiyev visits the kitchen to flatter Chef Barinov and offers him five hundred thousand rubles a month to return to Claude Monet.

scenes.title: The Michelin Inspector Rumor and the Sports Car
scenes.summary: Nagiyev tempts Chef Barinov with a rumor that a Michelin inspector is coming to Claude Monet and offers him a luxury car.

scenes.title: The Optimization Plan and Elena's Call
scenes.summary: Chef Barinov dismisses Max's kitchen optimization plan and then gets a call from Elena asking him to pick her up at the market.

scenes.title: A Fast Ride and Debates About the Star
scenes.summary: Chef Barinov impresses Elena with Nagiyev's sports car, while the cooks in the kitchen suspect Nagiyev is lying about the Michelin inspector.

scenes.title: Senya's Clue and the Hidden Car
scenes.summary: Katya follows the next clue in the kitchen while Chef Barinov hides Nagiyev's sports car and agrees to come to Claude Monet.

scenes.title: Max Becomes Chef for a Day
scenes.summary: Chef Barinov appoints Max acting head chef for a single day so he can secretly go to Claude Monet with Nagiyev.

scenes.title: The Grandfather's Clue and Fresh Ideas
scenes.summary: Katya receives a note from her father telling her to meet at the botanical garden at six, while Max takes charge of the kitchen.

scenes.title: Dish of the Day from Fish Trimmings
scenes.summary: Max turns Senya's fish trimmings into the dish of the day, so Fedya and Senya retaliate by plating a dish made of kitchen scraps.

scenes.title: Free Appetizers to the Hotel Rooms
scenes.summary: Max sends Senya and Fedya to deliver free appetizers to hotel rooms, where they confuse a French guest who speaks no Russian.

scenes.title: The Missing Eight-Million-Ruble Car
scenes.summary: Finding Nagiyev's sports car gone, Chef Barinov mistakes Nikita's romantic note for Katya for a car-theft ransom note.

scenes.title: The Immigration Raid and the French Notebook
scenes.summary: Katya is accidentally detained during an immigration check at the park, while the kitchen receives an order for the chef's special.

scenes.title: Signature Pâté Instead of the Medallion
scenes.summary: Max refuses to cook Chef Barinov's beef medallion and prepares his own pâté as the chef's special, while Louis reads the guest's notebook.

scenes.title: Waiting at Monet and Serving at Victor
scenes.summary: Nagiyev convinces Chef Barinov that a diner at Claude Monet is the Michelin inspector, while Max serves his pâté to the real inspector at Victor.

scenes.title: The Real Inspector Ate Max's Pâté
scenes.summary: Louis proves from the notebook that the Michelin inspector is actually at Restaurant Victor, and Lyova tells Chef Barinov that Max served him pâté.

scenes.title: The Bitter Truth from Eleonora
scenes.summary: Chef Barinov yells at Max for serving pâté to the inspector, and Eleonora reveals she only hired Victor out of pity when Katya begged her.

scenes.title: The Second Key and the Unfulfilled Date
scenes.summary: Nagiyev discovers that Chef Barinov hid the sports car himself and takes back the keys, while Nikita tells Katya about the date he planned.

scenes.title: The Review on the Michelin Website
scenes.summary: The Michelin inspector posts a glowing review of Restaurant Victor praising Max's dish, while Chef Barinov walks his own path.
